posts.text: Looking to amp up your deck? Check out the new #RBRadiance Alt Art Runes you can find in booster packs! Get your first hands-on experience with Radiance at Pre-Rift events starting October 16! Find an event near you at PlayRiftbound.com
Take your Gear straight to the battlefield with Deploy to gain an effect, but watch out! Your opponent might be waiting to respond. #RBRadiance

Get your first hands-on experience with #RBRadiance at Pre-Rift events, starting October 16! Check out the event locator at PlayRiftbound.com today to find your nearest store. Here's what to expect from a Pre-Rift: https://playriftbound.com/en-us/news/game-updates/preparing-for-the-radiance-pre-rift/

France, we're coming to you! We're heading to #PGW2026, bringing exclusive activities and merch for players at our booth! On se voit à Paris! 🇫🇷 More event details in the article: https://riot.com/4ylrL9f
